name: Sniper Bolts
body:
Your mystic bolts can strike at distant foes.

Prerequisite: Mystic bolts class feature.

Benefit(s): Increase the range of your mystic bolts by 15 feet. At 6th level and every 6 levels afterwards, the range of your mystic bolts increases by another 15 feet.
